title: Russian Double-Tap Drone Strike on Kryvyi Rih Shopping Mall Kills at Least 16, Injures 130
detail: Russian forces struck the 'Sunny Gallery' shopping and entertainment center in Kryvyi Rih, Dnipropetrovsk Oblast — President Zelensky's hometown — with jet-powered Shahed-type drones flying at extremely low altitude at around 16:30. A second drone hit the same building roughly 30 minutes later, while firefighters and medics were already responding, in what Ukrainian officials described as a deliberate 'double-tap' strike targeting rescuers. At least 16 people were killed (early reports cited 14-15 as the toll rose overnight) and 130 injured, including 23 children, with 29 in serious condition. Fire engulfed roughly a third of the complex; nine people, including two children, remained missing as rescuers dug through the wreckage. Zelensky called it 'an absolutely cynical and vile strike... against an ordinary shopping center' and 'simply an act of terrorism,' vowing a response and urging the international community to increase pressure on Russia.

title: Russian Loitering Munition Kills 4, Including 3 Children, in Mykolaiv Oblast Village
detail: A Russian 'suicide' loitering drone struck a building housing a shop, a Nova Poshta parcel branch, and a pharmacy in Tokarivka, Veselynivske settlement hromada, Mykolaiv Oblast, on the evening of August 21. The strike killed four people — two 11-year-old boys, a 13-year-old boy, and a 30-year-old man — and sparked a fire covering roughly 300 square meters. Mykolaiv Oblast authorities declared a day of mourning for the victims.

title: Russian Drone Strike Closes Ukraine-Moldova Border Crossing for Second Night in a Row
detail: Russia struck the Tabaki international border crossing with Moldova in Odesa Oblast overnight, damaging buildings and structures and starting fires that forced the checkpoint to close, with traffic redirected to other crossings. Moldova's Defense Ministry said preliminary information indicated the drone was a Shahed-136 (Geran-2). It was the second consecutive night Russia struck a Ukraine-Moldova crossing, following an attack on the nearby Reni-Giurgiulesti checkpoint during the large-scale overnight assault on Kyiv on August 20. Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha said the strikes were 'not isolated cases,' warning Russia is testing the resolve of NATO and its partners by violating neighboring states' sovereignty.
